trust_decision.summary: Whether a request carrying an existing Mcp-Session-Id may act on that session is decided only by session existence/idle-timeout in StreamableHTTPTransport (POST, GET, DELETE); there is no ownership binding (no Origin consistency, no caller hook).

landing_point.why: The summary says 'SSE Session Poisoning'; handle_get is the SSE stream route that attaches to a session by Mcp-Session-Id after only an existence check (line 482).

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST (non-initialize: notification, client response, regular request) with Mcp-Session-Id, handle_post
HTTP GET (SSE stream open) with Mcp-Session-Id, handle_get
HTTP DELETE (session termination) with Mcp-Session-Id, handle_delete
new private helper validate_session_request used by all three methods
HTTP POST initialize, handle_initialization records Origin into the session store
forbidden_response default message (shared with DNS-rebinding checks)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only one server HTTP transport exists (lib/mcp/server/transports/streamable_http_transport.rb); the other server transport is stdio (lib/mcp/server/transports/stdio_transport.rb), which has no sessions. All fix sites are in one file.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Notifications/client-response POSTs and DELETE 'do not run tools' and the report example is the SSE GET / tool-call path, so a solver may gate only GET or only regular requests and argue notifications/cancelled and responses are already scoped (handle_response checks pending_response[:session_id] at line 672).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-browser clients that send no Origin must keep working; initialize must stay exempt (it creates the session); stateless mode must not consult the validator; DNS-rebinding allow-listed cross origins must still pass rebinding but be rejected only on mismatch with the session's recorded Origin.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: lib/mcp/server/transports/streamable_http_transport.rb:933-940 (validate_origin allows nil Origin), :438-450 (initialize branch), :496-502 (stateless DELETE), fix.diff:228-265, fix.diff:367-383

O6_input_shapes: POST JSON-RPC regular request (has id and method)
POST JSON-RPC notification (method, no id), e.g. notifications/cancelled
POST JSON-RPC client response (id, no method; result or error)
Origin header present and matching / present and different / absent on either initialize or later request

O7_producer.where: lib/mcp/server/transports/streamable_http_transport.rb:708-712 (handle_initialization writes the session record; the fix adds origin there at fix.diff:174)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A GET resumability route (Last-Event-ID replay from an event store keyed by session) that attaches to a session without the ownership gate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code carries a TODO to add event store + replay; a maintainer adding it as a separate method/module would naturally reuse only validate_and_touch_session.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A batched/alternate client-response delivery path (e.g. a helper that pushes responses for several pending ids) that relies only on pending_response[:session_id] equality.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: handle_response already has its own per-session check, so a maintainer could believe responses are covered and skip the ownership gate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A lower-level public hook (e.g. transport-level cancel-by-session API) that reaches cancel_incoming for a session id taken from the request without the ownership gate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: cancel_incoming is a public ServerSession method and the README highlights cancellation; an integration helper exposing it is plausible.

O9_family: CWE-284 improper access control: missing session-to-client ownership binding (session hijack/poisoning via known session id)

O10_build.toolchain: Ruby >= 2.7, Bundler, Rake, Minitest (gemspec dep json_schemer; rack required by the transport)
O10_build.project_tests: test/mcp/server/transports/streamable_http_transport_test.rb (Rack request objects built in-process via create_rack_request; no network)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an ownership/Origin check only in handle_get (the SSE route) or only before handle_regular_request, leaving notification and client-response POSTs and DELETE open; or reject requests with no Origin, breaking non-browser clients.

out_of_scope_notes: Initialize with an Mcp-Session-Id header returns 400 vs 404 depending on session liveness (streamable_http_transport.rb:439-447), a session-existence oracle not gated by the fix.
In the fixed GET, validate_and_touch_session runs before the ownership gate, so a rejected request still extends the session's idle lifetime (fix.diff:117-119).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); tiny_repo inferred from lib/ holding about 51 .rb files.

The fix is largely an opt-in API (session_request_validator kwarg) plus an Origin-consistency default; hidden tests that call the new kwarg require the report to name it, otherwise only the Origin-consistency behaviour is fairly testable.
